title: Pre-change compatibility goldens
purpose: Freeze, by pointer, the pre-change (before S1, C*, R1, or R2) behavior of the highest-risk compatibility families -- MCP tool contracts, REST mappings, security/auth decisions, graph cold-start/degraded behavior, and cache identity -- and name, for every Wave 1 / early Wave 2 task, exactly which existing golden suites it is allowed to change. This is characterization only: no production behavior changes, no golden values are copied or duplicated here.

upstream_receipts.note: Q4a does not duplicate K0's frozen tool/REST/auth/artifact pointers. Q4a references config/ci/compatibility-rollback-envelope.json by path and adds the executable golden-suite inventory and per-task allow-list that K0 left for a later task.

validation_matrix.description: Every golden family below is required to be exercised by at least one existing suite covering each of these seven behaviors, per the Q4a plan-card validation clause.

mcp_manifest_and_output_schema.description: 52-tool manifest shape, discoverability metadata, and 14-tool converted JSON-schema structuredContent contract.

mcp_legacy_text_and_transport_parity.description: Legacy plain-text client compatibility, error-envelope parity, and transport (stdio vs HTTP) response-shape parity, including old-client snapshot fixtures.

rest_mappings.description: REST tool-route mappings, HTTP method/path shape, and non-tool routes (/health, /api/v1/status, /api/v1/retrieval/status).

security_auth_http_hardening.description: HTTP auth-scope decisions, loopback vs remote bind classification precursors, and the frozen local-transport contract that S1 must preserve for loopback while changing remote-bind default.

privacy_observability.description: Query-derived logging/audit privacy boundary that S2 must preserve (metadata-only diagnostics) while removing raw-query/hash emission.

graph_cold_start_degraded.description: Graph access/store cold-start, missing/corrupt/mismatched-fingerprint artifact handling, and explicit degraded status (never a broad fallback scan) that C2a must preserve while adding defensive validation.

git_status_correctness.description: Git porcelain XY-column parsing and status/total counts that C1 must correct without breaking existing staged/unstaged/mixed/rename/delete/conflict/untracked fixtures.

planning_contract.description: Planner depth/budget behavior, saved-plan JSON/Markdown schema, and generated/refined plan shape that C0a must extend additively.

cache_identity_and_semantic_cache.description: Service-client cache-key construction (commit-aware / semantic-search cache reuse) and reactive ResponseCache multi-layer behavior that C3 must extend to a fully versioned, collision-resistant key without breaking unchanged-request cache hits.
cache_identity_and_semantic_cache.notes: tests/serviceClient.test.ts 'Cache Management' and 'Semantic Search (openai_session default)' describe blocks exercise getCommitAwareCacheKey(); this is the pre-change golden for C3's collision matrix.

reactive_numeric_config.description: Bounded/parsed reactive numeric environment configuration (timeouts, worker counts, circuit breaker, chunking) that C4 must define fail/default/clamp behavior for.
reactive_numeric_config.gap_note: No dedicated tests/config/env.test.ts exists yet for envBool/envMs/envPerfProfile boundary cases. C4 is expected to add that suite as part of its own change; Q4a records the gap explicitly rather than inventing a synthetic pre-change golden.

cancellation_and_session_placeholders.description: Placeholder golden family for R1a/R1b/R1c cancellation work and R2 bounded-session work. No cancellation vocabulary exists yet, so this family points only at the existing error/parity/session suites that already characterize today's (uncancellable) request lifecycle; R1a/R2 must not regress these while adding the new contract.
cancellation_and_session_placeholders.note: Q4b (Wave 3) is the hard post-change gate for cancellation/session parity; this family is the pre-change reference it diffs against.

S1.task_title: Fail closed for unauthenticated non-loopback HTTP
S1.rationale: S1 changes bind-target classification and auth-readiness gating in httpServer.ts/authScopes.ts, so it owns the hardening/auth-scope suites; the frozen local-transport contract and compatibility matrix stay as the loopback-preserving baseline unless S1 records an intentional delta.

S2.rationale: S2 touches serviceClientRuntimeAccess.ts logging only; it owns the audit/privacy suites and must not need to touch serviceClient cache/search behavior tests.

C2a.rationale: C2a adds workspace/schema/source/fingerprint validation ahead of graph hydration; it owns the persisted-store cold-start suite and may add new degraded fixtures there, but must not need to change graph-native tool registration/output contracts.

C1.rationale: C1 is scoped to the Git porcelain parser and its own fixture suite.

C0a.task_title: Explicit planner depth and budget contract
C0a.rationale: C0a adds an additive depth/budget request-and-report contract; saved-plan JSON/Markdown persistence and lifecycle contracts must remain byte-for-byte compatible unless an intentional delta is recorded.

C3.rationale: C3 is the approved task allowed to change cache-key composition; per the compatibility envelope's rollback policy, any resulting cache-key-format delta is intentional (namespace bump), never a silent collision-prone edit.

C4.rationale: C4 owns reactive/config.ts and src/config/env.ts numeric parsing; the family is marked characterization_gap because no dedicated boundary-case suite exists pre-change, so C4 is expected to add one rather than modify an existing frozen golden.

R1a.rationale: R1a defines the first cancellation vocabulary; Q4a/F9 is read-only input per the plan card, so R1a may extend the error/transport-parity suites with new cancellation cases but must not regress existing timeout/zombie-session characterization. Q4b (Wave 3) is the hard post-change gate.

R2.rationale: R2 adds idle TTL/hard cap/eviction to existing stateful session semantics; it owns the session-lifecycle suites and must preserve the S1 auth-decision suites it depends on.

inheritance_note.description: Tasks not enumerated in task_golden_map above inherit their pre-change golden posture from the families their dependency chain already touches, and are gated for post-change parity by Q4b rather than re-deriving a Q4a entry.

rollback_policy.update_rule: A golden fixture/suite listed under allowed_to_change for a task may change only as part of that task's own reviewed commit, with an intentional-delta entry appended to config/ci/compatibility-rollback-envelope.json intentional_deltas (or this file's own delta ledger below) describing what changed and why.
rollback_policy.revert_rule: Revert only the specific task's suite changes; never bulk-restore or bulk-rewrite goldens belonging to a different task's family.
